question: Can an actual Unity-based furnished scene, skinned child-proportioned embodiment, articulated hand, and body-derived head camera produce a 5-8 second clip visibly more credible than the prior MIMo footage?

unity.license: Unity Personal assigned; proprietary Unity Editor dependency

avatar.source: MPFB/MakeHuman age-minimum rigged output retained from Phase 1
avatar.properties: skinned child-proportioned mesh; full articulated five-finger chains

room.unit_rule: 1 Unity unit = 1 meter; uniform scale derives from measured raw Renderer.bounds and explicit metric target size

camera.construction: world-meter optical point 0.032 m beyond measured rest-pose head-weighted bounds, then frozen under head

repair.kenney_scale_defect: repaired from measured raw and world bounds
repair.skin_binding: all audited arm/wrist/finger transforms are exact SkinnedMeshRenderer.bones instances with nonzero weights
repair.manual_render_fix: BakeMesh(useScale=true) rendered each frame with importer transform exactly once; duplicate source draw excluded

motion_disclosure: All animation, CCD IK, finger closure, and touch are kinematic/nonphysical. The target is static. No simulator-truth or side streams were generated.

judgment.room_coherence: pass: metrically normalized furnished room and support read consistently, though sparser than MIMo
judgment.child_embodiment: pass: actual weighted child forearm and hand remain attached and visible
judgment.head_camera: pass: measured external optical origin, fixed body-derived mount, no target lock
judgment.horizon_roll_fov: pass: stable zero-roll composition, 62-degree vertical FOV
judgment.hand_anatomy: pass: smooth five-finger skinned hand, no duplicated or malformed digits
judgment.reach_touch: pass: approach, visible touch, and withdraw are readable
judgment.clipping: pass: no head, near-plane, torso, or limb takeover
judgment.temporal_naturalness: pass for visual feasibility; deterministic kinematic motion remains disclosed

governance.only_recommended_next_gate: register this exact visible rig and camera to the existing MuJoCo trace/physics contract under separate authorization
